## Overview

Hydrographic values **derived** from the CalCOFI Bottle Database rather than measured:
spice and the TEOS-10 sigma-theta at every bottle, back to the start of the record
(1949). Asked for by Nastassia Patin (spice at each bottle depth, 2026-10-16) and
Rasmus Swalethorp (thread "calcofi derived data", 2026-10-19: "keeping derived values
in a separate dataset. Back calculating spice and sigma theta to the beginning using
the values in the bottle database"); Ben Best's reply (2026-10-20): "a separate
bottle-derived dataset, back-calculated from the start of the record. From the bottle
database's own temperature and salinity … Spiciness and TEOS-10 sigma theta go in
first." The other bottle-derived values (IntC14, integrated chlorophyll) join this
dataset once the DECODR source arrives.

- **Source**: the `calcofi_bottle` ingest's `temperature` (`T_degC`) and `salinity`
  (`Salnty`) per bottle, with their quality codes (`T_qual`, `S_qual`), its depth and
  its cast's position — read from that ingest's staged output when it is current,
  otherwise from the release (see [Input](#input)).
- **The rule is one tested calcofi4db function**, `bottle_spice_sigma0()`: sea pressure
  from depth and latitude (`gsw_p_from_z`), absolute salinity, conservative temperature,
  then `gsw_spiciness0` (by `ctd_spice()`, the rule the CTD series uses) and
  `gsw_sigma0`. This notebook only applies it.
- **Flags first.** A bottle whose temperature or salinity the provider flags 8
  (suspect) or 9 (missing) gets neither value: a derived value carries no flag, so
  nothing downstream could undo a flagged input (`measurement-bounds` skill).
- **The legacy value stays.** The bottle database's own `sigma_theta` (computed by
  DECODR's algorithm) is untouched in `calcofi_bottle`; `sigma_theta_teos10` is the
  modern value beside it (Rasmus Swalethorp, 2026-10-16: "keep legacy, add modern,
  document"). Where the two disagree by more than 0.1 kg m⁻³ the bottle is listed for
  the provider ([Findings](#findings)).

```{mermaid}
graph LR
  A[calcofi_bottle<br/>temperature + salinity<br/>per bottle, with T_qual / S_qual] --> B[drop 8/9 flags]
  B --> C[bottle_spice_sigma0:<br/>p from depth, SA, CT]
  C --> D[(obs: spiciness0,<br/>sigma_theta_teos10<br/>on the bottle's sample)]
```

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
# a development checkout of calcofi4db only when asked (CALCOFI4DB_DIR, as
# build_workflows_index.R does); a pipeline render uses the installed package
if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("CALCOFI4DB_DIR")))
  devtools::load_all(Sys.getenv("CALCOFI4DB_DIR"), quiet = TRUE)
librarian::shelf(
  CalCOFI/calcofi4db, CalCOFI/calcofi4r,
  DBI, dplyr, DT, fs, glue, here, jsonlite, purrr, readr, tibble, tidyr,
  quiet = T)
options(readr.show_col_types = F)
options(DT.options = list(scrollX = TRUE))
stopifnot(
  "calcofi4db >= 4.27.0 carries bottle_spice_sigma0() and add_measurement_source_dataset()" =
    exists("bottle_spice_sigma0", mode = "function") &&
    exists("add_measurement_source_dataset", mode = "function"))

source(here("libs/ingest.R"))
cc <- read_calcofi_meta(here("ingest_calcofi_bottle-derived.qmd"))
provider     <- cc$provider
dataset      <- cc$dataset
dataset_name <- cc$dataset_meta$dataset_name
tables_owned <- cc$tables_owned
ds_key       <- glue("{provider}_{dataset}")
src_key      <- "calcofi_bottle"
dir_label    <- ds_key
dir_meta     <- here(glue("metadata/{provider}/{dataset}"))
dir_parquet  <- here(glue("data/parquet/{dir_label}"))
dir_stage    <- cc_stage_path("parquet", dir_label, create = TRUE)
db_path      <- here(glue("data/wrangling/{dir_label}.duckdb"))
meas_type_csv <- here("metadata/measurement_type.csv")

# the source series, by their calcofi_bottle measurement_type
src_types <- c(temperature = "temperature", salinity = "salinity", legacy = "sigma_theta")
# a legacy-vs-TEOS-10 difference larger than this is listed for the provider; the
# release v2026.10.14 comparison over 199,918 bottles had a median of 0.0037 kg/m3
# and a p95 of 0.0087, so 0.1 is about ten times the p95 and is not a rounding effect
diff_list_kg_m3 <- 0.1

if (overwrite) {
  for (f in c(db_path, paste0(db_path, ".wal"))) if (file_exists(f)) file_delete(f)
}
dir_create(dirname(db_path))
con <- get_duckdb_con(db_path)
```

## Input {#input}

The preferred input is the `calcofi_bottle` ingest's own staged output under
`cc_stage_dir()` — the bytes the next release will be cut from — used only if it is
**current**: its `obs` and `sample` row counts must equal what that ingest's committed
`manifest.json` recorded (its `data_hash` starts with the row count). Otherwise the
notebook reads the promoted release's `obs_env` (the temperature, salinity and
sigma-theta partitions only) and `sample` through the resolver helpers
(`cc_catalog()` / `cc_release_sources()`), never a hand-built path.

```{r}
#| label: input
dir_src <- cc_stage_path("parquet", src_key)
mf_src  <- read_json(here(glue("data/parquet/{src_key}/manifest.json")))
rows_of <- function(h) sum(vapply(as.list(unlist(h)), function(x) as.numeric(sub(":.*$", "", x)), numeric(1)))
types_in <- paste0("'", src_types, "'", collapse = ", ")

# the staged obs is one file or a hive-partitioned directory; either is read the same way
src_obs_sql <- local({
  if (dir_exists(path(dir_src, "obs")))
    glue("read_parquet('{dir_src}/obs/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning = true)")
  else glue("read_parquet('{dir_src}/obs.parquet')")
})
stage_current <- local({
  f_smp <- path(dir_src, "sample.parquet")
  if (!dir_exists(dir_src) || !file_exists(f_smp) ||
      !(file_exists(path(dir_src, "obs.parquet")) || dir_exists(path(dir_src, "obs")))) return(FALSE)
  got_obs <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM {src_obs_sql}"))$n
  got_smp <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM read_parquet('{f_smp}')"))$n
  exp_obs <- rows_of(mf_src$data_hash$obs); exp_smp <- rows_of(mf_src$data_hash$sample)
  ok <- got_obs == exp_obs && got_smp == exp_smp
  cat(glue("stage {dir_src}: obs {got_obs} / {exp_obs}, sample {got_smp} / {exp_smp} -> ",
           "{if (ok) 'CURRENT' else 'NOT current'}"), "\n")
  ok
})

if (stage_current) {
  input_used <- glue("staged calcofi_bottle output ({dir_src}), current against its committed manifest.json")
  dbExecute(con, glue("
    CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW src_obs AS
    SELECT sample_key, measurement_type, measurement_value, measurement_qual,
           grid_key, cruise_key, latitude, longitude, datetime, depth_min_m, depth_max_m
    FROM {src_obs_sql}
    WHERE dataset_key = '{src_key}' AND measurement_type IN ({types_in})"))
  dbExecute(con, glue("
    CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW src_sample AS
    SELECT sample_key, sample_type, site_key FROM read_parquet('{dir_src}/sample.parquet')
    WHERE dataset_key = '{src_key}'"))
} else {
  cat_ <- calcofi4r::cc_catalog("latest")
  input_used <- glue("release {cat_$version} obs_env + sample via cc_release_sources() (the stage was absent or not current)")
  invisible(dbExecute(con, "INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs"))
  src_env <- calcofi4r::cc_release_sources(cat_, "obs_env")
  keep <- grepl(glue("measurement_type=({paste(src_types, collapse = '|')})/"), src_env$urls)
  stopifnot("the release must carry every source partition" = sum(keep) == length(src_types))
  src_env$urls <- src_env$urls[keep]
  # obs_env names the value `value`; the core assembly grain names it measurement_value
  dbExecute(con, paste0("
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE src_obs AS
    SELECT sample_key, measurement_type, value AS measurement_value, measurement_qual,
           grid_key, cruise_key, latitude, longitude, datetime, depth_min_m, depth_max_m
    FROM ", calcofi4r::cc_read_parquet_sql(src_env), "
    WHERE dataset_key = '", src_key, "'"))
  dbExecute(con, paste0("
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE src_sample AS
    SELECT sample_key, sample_type, site_key FROM ",
    calcofi4r::cc_read_parquet_sql(calcofi4r::cc_release_sources(cat_, "sample")), "
    WHERE dataset_key = '", src_key, "'"))
}
cat(glue("input: {input_used}"), "\n")
```

## Bottles

One row per bottle with its temperature, salinity and the legacy sigma-theta, each
with its quality code, plus the bottle's depth and its cast's position and time
(carried on every bottle obs row).

```{r}
#| label: bottles
col_of <- function(nm, tp) glue("
  MAX(measurement_value) FILTER (WHERE measurement_type = '{tp}') AS {nm},
  MAX(regexp_replace(CAST(measurement_qual AS VARCHAR), '\\.0+$', ''))
    FILTER (WHERE measurement_type = '{tp}') AS q_{nm},
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE measurement_type = '{tp}') AS n_{nm}")
dbExecute(con, glue("
  CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE btl AS
  SELECT sample_key,
         ANY_VALUE(grid_key) AS grid_key, ANY_VALUE(cruise_key) AS cruise_key,
         ANY_VALUE(latitude) AS latitude, ANY_VALUE(longitude) AS longitude,
         ANY_VALUE(datetime) AS datetime,
         MIN(depth_min_m) AS depth_m, MAX(depth_min_m) AS depth_m_max,
         {paste(imap_chr(src_types, ~ col_of(.y, .x)), collapse = ',\n')}
  FROM src_obs
  GROUP BY sample_key"))

d_btl_chk <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS bottles,
         MAX(n_temperature) AS max_t, MAX(n_salinity) AS max_s, MAX(n_legacy) AS max_legacy,
         SUM(CASE WHEN depth_m <> depth_m_max THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_depth_disagree,
         SUM(CASE WHEN temperature IS NOT NULL AND salinity IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_t_and_s,
         MIN(datetime) FILTER (WHERE temperature IS NOT NULL AND salinity IS NOT NULL) AS first_t_and_s,
         MAX(datetime) FILTER (WHERE temperature IS NOT NULL AND salinity IS NOT NULL) AS last_t_and_s
  FROM btl")
d_btl_chk |> datatable(caption = "Bottles carrying a source series", rownames = FALSE)
stopifnot(
  "a bottle carries one temperature, one salinity and one legacy sigma-theta at most" =
    d_btl_chk$max_t <= 1 && d_btl_chk$max_s <= 1 && d_btl_chk$max_legacy <= 1,
  "a bottle has one depth" = d_btl_chk$n_depth_disagree == 0,
  "every source key is a calcofi_bottle bottle" = dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM btl b LEFT JOIN src_sample s USING (sample_key)
    WHERE s.sample_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'bottle'")$n == 0)

dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT 'temperature' AS series, q_temperature AS qual, COUNT(*) AS bottles
  FROM btl WHERE temperature IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'salinity', q_salinity, COUNT(*) FROM btl WHERE salinity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
  ORDER BY 1, 2") |>
  datatable(caption = "Quality codes on the bottles' temperature and salinity (8 = suspect, 9 = missing are dropped; 6 = ok, taken from the CTD)", rownames = FALSE)
```

## Compute the Products

```{r}
#| label: compute
d <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT sample_key, temperature, q_temperature, salinity, q_salinity, legacy, q_legacy,
         depth_m, latitude, longitude
  FROM btl WHERE temperature IS NOT NULL AND salinity IS NOT NULL")
t0 <- Sys.time()
r <- bottle_spice_sigma0(d$temperature, d$salinity, d$depth_m, d$longitude, d$latitude,
                         q_temperature = d$q_temperature, q_salinity = d$q_salinity)
d <- bind_cols(d, r)
cat(glue("computed {format(nrow(d), big.mark = ',')} bottles in {format(round(Sys.time() - t0, 1))}"), "\n")
dbWriteTable(con, "derived", as.data.frame(
  select(d, sample_key, pressure_dbar, spiciness0, sigma_theta_teos10)), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Assert the Flag Rule

A value its provider flags 8 or 9 never enters a derived value; every bottle with a
good temperature and salinity at a known depth and position gets both values.

```{r}
#| label: flag-audit
is_flagged <- function(q) sub("\\.0+$", "", as.character(q)) %in% c("8", "9")
flagged <- is_flagged(d$q_temperature) | is_flagged(d$q_salinity)
placed  <- is.finite(d$depth_m) & is.finite(d$latitude) & is.finite(d$longitude)
fa <- tibble(
  bottles_t_and_s          = nrow(d),
  t_or_s_flagged_8_9       = sum(flagged),
  t_flagged                = sum(is_flagged(d$q_temperature)),
  s_flagged                = sum(is_flagged(d$q_salinity)),
  no_depth_or_position     = sum(!flagged & !placed),
  flagged_with_value       = sum(flagged & (!is.na(d$spiciness0) | !is.na(d$sigma_theta_teos10))),
  good_without_value       = sum(!flagged & placed & (is.na(d$spiciness0) | is.na(d$sigma_theta_teos10))),
  derived                  = sum(!is.na(d$sigma_theta_teos10)))
fa |> datatable(caption = "Flag audit over every bottle with a temperature and a salinity", rownames = FALSE)
stopifnot(
  "a flagged temperature or salinity must yield no derived value" = fa$flagged_with_value == 0,
  "a good bottle at a known depth and position must get both values" = fa$good_without_value == 0,
  "spice and sigma-theta are present together" =
    all(is.na(d$spiciness0) == is.na(d$sigma_theta_teos10)))
```

## Register Measurement Types

`spiciness0` is **reused** under this dataset (Ben Best, D8, 2026-10-20): the same
quantity by the same rule (`ctd_spice()`), so a reader filters one key by
`dataset_key`. Its row is defined by `calcofi_ctd-derived`, which keeps the
description, units, derivation and bound; this ingest only adds itself to the row's
`_source_datasets` (`add_measurement_source_dataset()`). `sigma_theta_teos10` is
**new** (D8): appended with `register_measurement_types()`, its registry-owned fields
set with `declare_measurement_fields()`, its bound with
`declare_measurement_bounds()`. It is not the bottle's `sigma_theta` (DECODR's legacy
algorithm, labelled so in its own row) and it does not join that key's `variable`:
both come from the same bottles, and a crosswalk unifies series that are not the same
physical samples.

**No bound is invented or taken from the data.** The sigma-theta bound is
`gsw_sigma0` over the bottle's registered temperature × salinity bounds at 0 dbar,
rounded outward — what the registry already calls physically possible (question
Q02). The reused `spiciness0` bound (−25 to 18, `calcofi_ctd-derived` Q07) is checked
to cover the same grid.

```{r}
#| label: register-types
d_mt0 <- read_measurement_type(meas_type_csv)
src_mt <- function(tp) filter(d_mt0, measurement_type == tp)
t_b <- src_mt("temperature"); s_b <- src_mt("salinity"); sp0 <- src_mt("spiciness0")
stopifnot(nrow(t_b) == 1, nrow(s_b) == 1,
          "spiciness0 is defined by calcofi_ctd-derived and must exist" = nrow(sp0) == 1)

new_type <- tibble(
  measurement_type   = "sigma_theta_teos10",
  description        = "Potential density anomaly (sigma-theta, TEOS-10) per bottle, from the bottle's own temperature and salinity",
  units              = "kg/m3",
  grain              = "obs",
  `_source_column`   = "temperature; salinity; depth",
  `_source_table`    = "obs",
  `_source_datasets` = ds_key,
  `_qual_column`     = NA_character_,
  `_prec_column`     = NA_character_)
d_meas_type <- register_measurement_types(new_type, meas_type_csv)
# derivation, is_canonical, category and the NERC ids are registry-owned: this ingest
# owns the row, so it declares them deliberately (overwrite = TRUE)
d_meas_type <- declare_measurement_fields(
  tibble(
    measurement_type = "sigma_theta_teos10",
    category         = "Physical Oceanography",
    derivation       = paste(
      "calcofi4db::bottle_spice_sigma0(): sea pressure gsw_p_from_z(-depth, latitude), then",
      "gsw_SA_from_SP, gsw_CT_from_t, gsw_sigma0 (TEOS-10, IOC/SCOR/IAPSO 2010) on the bottle's",
      "own temperature (T_degC) and salinity (Salnty); a bottle whose T_qual or S_qual is 8 or 9",
      "has none. The bottle database's own sigma_theta is DECODR's legacy value, kept beside it"),
    is_canonical     = "TRUE",
    # exact match: potential density anomaly {Sigma-0} of the water body by computation from
    # absolute salinity and conservative temperature, UNESCO 2010 (= TEOS-10); checked against
    # the NVS SPARQL endpoint 2026-10-20, not deprecated
    nerc_p01         = "http://vocab.nerc.ac.uk/collection/P01/current/SIGTPR03/",
    units_nerc_p06   = src_mt("sigma_theta")$units_nerc_p06),
  meas_type_csv, categories = read_csv(here("metadata/category.csv"))$category,
  overwrite = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
d_meas_type <- add_measurement_source_dataset("spiciness0", ds_key, meas_type_csv)

ts_grid <- expand.grid(t = seq(t_b$valid_min, t_b$valid_max, 1),
                       s = seq(s_b$valid_min, s_b$valid_max, 1))
sa_g <- gsw::gsw_SA_from_SP(ts_grid$s, 0, -120, 33)
ct_g <- gsw::gsw_CT_from_t(sa_g, ts_grid$t, 0)
sig_g <- gsw::gsw_sigma0(sa_g, ct_g); sp_g <- gsw::gsw_spiciness0(sa_g, ct_g)
stopifnot(
  "the reused spiciness0 bound must cover the bottle's registered T x S bounds" =
    sp0$valid_min <= min(sp_g) && sp0$valid_max >= max(sp_g))

bounds <- tribble(
  ~measurement_type,    ~valid_min,        ~valid_max,          ~why,
  "sigma_theta_teos10", floor(min(sig_g)), ceiling(max(sig_g)), "gsw_sigma0 over the registered bottle temperature x salinity bounds at 0 dbar, rounded outward (Q02)")
d_meas_type <- declare_measurement_bounds(select(bounds, -why), meas_type_csv, overwrite = TRUE)
bounds |>
  bind_rows(tibble(measurement_type = "spiciness0", valid_min = sp0$valid_min, valid_max = sp0$valid_max,
                   why = "reused: declared by calcofi_ctd-derived (its Q07); covers the bottle T x S grid")) |>
  datatable(caption = "Declared bounds and where each comes from", rownames = FALSE)
stopifnot(
  "this dataset is listed on both of its types" = all(vapply(
    c("spiciness0", "sigma_theta_teos10"), function(tp) ds_key %in% strsplit(
      filter(d_meas_type, measurement_type == tp)$`_source_datasets`, ";")[[1]], logical(1))),
  "spiciness0 keeps calcofi_ctd-derived" = grepl("calcofi_ctd-derived",
    filter(d_meas_type, measurement_type == "spiciness0")$`_source_datasets`, fixed = TRUE))
dbWriteTable(con, "measurement_type", as.data.frame(d_meas_type), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Load Dataset Metadata

```{r}
#| label: load-dataset-metadata
this_provider <- provider; this_dataset <- dataset
d_dataset <- ingest_yaml_to_dataset_df(read_ingest_yaml(here())) |>
  filter(provider == this_provider, dataset == this_dataset)
stopifnot(nrow(d_dataset) == 1)
dbWriteTable(con, "dataset", as.data.frame(d_dataset), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Emit Core Tables

**Per bottle → `obs`**, on the bottle's `calcofi_bottle` `sample_key`, at the bottle's
depth; position, time, grid and cruise come from the same bottle row, so a derived
value lines up with the temperature and salinity it came from and the release
`climatology` covers it with no special case. This dataset emits **no `sample`**: the
bottle is `calcofi_bottle`'s, and a second row with the same key would break the
global uniqueness `assemble_core()` asserts.

```{r}
#| label: emit-core
for (tp in c("spiciness0", "sigma_theta_teos10"))
  append_obs(con, glue("
    SELECT 'env', '{ds_key}', b.sample_key, b.grid_key, b.cruise_key,
           b.latitude, b.longitude, b.datetime, b.depth_m, b.depth_m,
           NULL::VARCHAR, NULL::VARCHAR, '{tp}', x.{tp}, NULL::VARCHAR, NULL::DOUBLE
    FROM btl b JOIN derived x USING (sample_key)
    WHERE x.{tp} IS NOT NULL"))

n_obs <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT measurement_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM obs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1")
n_obs |> datatable(caption = "core projection: obs rows per type", rownames = FALSE)
stopifnot(
  "one obs row per derived bottle and type" = all(n_obs$n == fa$derived),
  "both types emitted" = nrow(n_obs) == 2)
```

## Check Measurement Bounds

```{r}
#| label: bounds
b_obs <- check_measurement_bounds(con, "obs", mt = d_meas_type, dataset_key = ds_key)
bounds_datatable(b_obs)
stopifnot(
  "every derived type is bounded" = all(b_obs$status != "undeclared"),
  "no derived value breaks its bound" = all(b_obs$status != "out_of_range"))
```

## Findings for the Provider {#findings}

Values inside the generous bounds are **not deleted**: a bound catches the impossible.
Two lists go to the provider (question Q03): bottles where the TEOS-10 sigma-theta and
the bottle database's own (legacy, DECODR) sigma-theta differ by more than
`r diff_list_kg_m3` kg m⁻³ — a gap that size is not the algorithm, it is one of the
inputs (a temperature or salinity the legacy value was not computed from) — and spice
below −3 kg m⁻³, which needs a practical salinity near 20, the same class of fault the
CTD derived products list (`calcofi_ctd-derived` Q08).

At the first render (2026-10-20) nearly all of both lists is one cruise: on every bottle
of 2021-05-3322 the published salinity equals the bottle's own sigma-theta, so the
`Salnty` column carries sigma-theta for that cruise. That is `calcofi_bottle` Q13
(proposed: treat those salinities as invalid once the provider confirms); this dataset
follows it rather than deciding it here, because its source code is blank (good, by
`calcofi_bottle` Q01) and the values sit inside the generous bounds.

```{r}
#| label: findings
d_diff <- d |>
  filter(!is.na(sigma_theta_teos10), !is.na(legacy), !is_flagged(q_legacy)) |>
  mutate(diff = sigma_theta_teos10 - legacy)
d_diff_sum <- d_diff |>
  summarize(bottles = n(),
            median_abs = median(abs(diff)), p95_abs = quantile(abs(diff), 0.95),
            p99_abs = quantile(abs(diff), 0.99), max_abs = max(abs(diff)),
            n_gt_0.01 = sum(abs(diff) > 0.01), n_gt_0.1 = sum(abs(diff) > diff_list_kg_m3),
            n_gt_1 = sum(abs(diff) > 1))
d_diff_sum |> mutate(across(ends_with("_abs"), ~ signif(.x, 3))) |>
  datatable(caption = "TEOS-10 minus the bottle database's sigma_theta (kg/m3), over bottles with both and an unflagged legacy value", rownames = FALSE)

d_diff_odd <- d_diff |>
  filter(abs(diff) > diff_list_kg_m3) |>
  left_join(dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT sample_key, cruise_key, datetime FROM btl"), by = "sample_key") |>
  transmute(sample_key, cruise_key, date = as.Date(datetime), depth_m,
            temperature, q_temperature, salinity, q_salinity,
            sigma_theta_legacy = round(legacy, 3), q_legacy,
            sigma_theta_teos10 = round(sigma_theta_teos10, 3), diff = round(diff, 3)) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(diff)))
d_diff_odd |> datatable(caption = glue(
  "Bottles where TEOS-10 and legacy sigma-theta differ by more than {diff_list_kg_m3} kg/m3: ",
  "{nrow(d_diff_odd)} (question Q03)"), rownames = FALSE, filter = "top")

d_spice_odd <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT b.cruise_key, b.sample_key, b.depth_m, ROUND(x.spiciness0, 2) AS spice,
         ROUND(x.sigma_theta_teos10, 2) AS sigma_theta_teos10
  FROM derived x JOIN btl b USING (sample_key)
  WHERE x.spiciness0 < -3 ORDER BY x.spiciness0")
d_spice_odd |> datatable(caption = glue(
  "Spice below -3 kg/m3: {nrow(d_spice_odd)} bottles (question Q03)"), rownames = FALSE)
```

## Relationships

```{r}
#| label: relationships
stopifnot(
  "every obs.sample_key is a calcofi_bottle bottle" =
    dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM obs o LEFT JOIN src_sample s USING (sample_key)
                     WHERE s.sample_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'bottle'")$n == 0,
  "every measurement_type is registered" =
    dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM obs
                     WHERE measurement_type NOT IN (SELECT measurement_type FROM measurement_type)")$n == 0,
  "one obs row per bottle and type" =
    dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT sample_key, measurement_type FROM obs
                     GROUP BY ALL HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)")$n == 0)

tbls_out <- core_output_tables(con, extra = c("measurement_type", "dataset"))
rels <- core_relationships(tbls_out)
cc_erd(con, tables = c("obs", "measurement_type"), rels = rels,
       colors = list(lightblue = "obs", lightyellow = "measurement_type"))
```

| source (calcofi_bottle `obs`) | core | transform |
|---|---|---|
| `temperature`, `salinity` + `T_qual`, `S_qual`, the bottle's depth and its cast's position | `obs.measurement_type = spiciness0` | `bottle_spice_sigma0()` → `ctd_spice()` at `gsw_p_from_z(-depth, latitude)` |
| the same | `obs.measurement_type = sigma_theta_teos10` | `bottle_spice_sigma0()`: `gsw_sigma0` |
| `sigma_theta` (legacy, DECODR) | **not published here**; compared in [Findings](#findings) | |

: Source → core mapping {#tbl-mapping}

## Validate

`validate_for_release()` treats every `_key` column as required. The NULLs below are
declared with their reason and count; anything undeclared, or a count that moved,
fails the render.

```{r}
#| label: validate
# the expected NULL counts, derived independently of the table being checked (from
# the source bottles that got a value, not from obs)
n_exp <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_obs,
         2 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.grid_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_grid_null,
         2 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.cruise_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_cruise_null
  FROM btl b JOIN derived x USING (sample_key) WHERE x.sigma_theta_teos10 IS NOT NULL")
# the wrangling tables are not outputs; drop them so the validator sees what ships. The
# src_* inputs are views (stage) or tables (release), and DuckDB refuses DROP VIEW on a
# table, so each is dropped as what it is
for (tb in c("btl", "derived", "src_obs", "src_sample")) {
  kind <- dbGetQuery(con, glue(
    "SELECT table_type FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = '{tb}'"))$table_type
  if (length(kind))
    dbExecute(con, glue("DROP {if (grepl('VIEW', kind[1])) 'VIEW' else 'TABLE'} IF EXISTS {tb}"))
}
results <- validate_for_release(con, checks = "all", strict = FALSE)
nullable <- tribble(
  ~table, ~column,      ~n,                       ~reason,
  "obs",  "taxon_key",  2 * n_exp$n_obs,          "env realm: a derived physical quantity names no organism",
  "obs",  "grid_key",   n_exp$n_grid_null,        "inherited: the calcofi_bottle cast has no grid cell",
  "obs",  "cruise_key", n_exp$n_cruise_null,      "inherited: the calcofi_bottle cast's cruise is not resolved") |>
  filter(n > 0)
found <- tibble(msg = results$errors) |>
  mutate(table  = sub("^Table '([^']+)'.*$", "\\1", msg),
         column = sub("^.*required column '([^']+)'.*$", "\\1", msg),
         n      = suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^Table '[^']+' has (\\d+) NULL.*$", "\\1", msg))))
unexplained <- anti_join(found, nullable, by = c("table", "column"))
moved <- inner_join(found, nullable, by = c("table", "column"), suffix = c("", "_decl")) |>
  filter(!is.na(n_decl), n != n_decl)
nullable |> left_join(select(found, table, column, n_found = n), by = c("table", "column")) |>
  datatable(caption = "Declared NULLs vs what validate_for_release() found", rownames = FALSE)
if (nrow(unexplained)) print(unexplained$msg)
stopifnot(
  "a NULL appeared with no declared reason" = nrow(unexplained) == 0,
  "a declared NULL count has changed"       = nrow(moved) == 0)
```

## Write Parquet Outputs

```{r}
#| label: write-parquet
d_tbls_rd <- read_csv(glue("{dir_meta}/tbls_redefine.csv"))
d_flds_rd <- read_csv(glue("{dir_meta}/flds_redefine.csv"))
dir_create(dir_parquet)
tbls_out <- core_output_tables(con, extra = c("measurement_type", "dataset"))
parquet_stats <- write_parquet_outputs(
  con = con, output_dir = dir_parquet, tables = tbls_out,
  sort_by = list(obs = c("grid_key", "measurement_type", "depth_min_m")),
  strip_provenance = FALSE)
build_relationships_json(rels = rels, output_dir = dir_parquet, provider = provider, dataset = dataset)
parquet_stats |> mutate(file = basename(path)) |> select(-path) |>
  datatable(caption = "Parquet export statistics")
```
